instruction: Buy a USB-C charging cable. Ignore 'Hot Deals' / 'Featured Deal' banners and use the search bar.
notes: Walmart homepage loads cleanly headlessly on most visits. If you hit the PRESS-AND-HOLD CAPTCHA (intermittent), pre-warm cookies: python warm_session.py --url https://www.walmart.com/ --out data/walmart_storage_state.json, then add 'storage_state': 'data/walmart_storage_state.json' to this task config. Homepage has: search bar + hero product carousel + 'Departments' distractor + 'Add' buttons — close to ShopGym's structure.
